name: Rachael Pull
story: Rachael Pull worked at Far North District Council as a Specialist Planner on reserves and urban-design work. Eagle’s 2020 virtual user conference records Pull and Logan Ashmore presenting a GIS-based framework for the council’s open-space programme, with GIS used as the source for later strategies and decision tools.
